No dry chemical system, deluge water system or safety shut down sysem could have saved the living quarters or anything else within the blast flame direction from the choke body within the closing time of the SSV. The 150 pound dry chemical wheeled unit adjacent to the living quarters would not have slowed the blaze. There was no fire wall or shield (such as an A-60 barrier) located between the choke manifold, production equipment, meter runs, and the living quarters.
